overview.zh: 先区分 Core i、Core、Core Ultra 和 N 系列，再看代数、编号与后缀。
overview.en: Start with the family: Core i, Core, Core Ultra, or N-series. Then read its generation, SKU, and suffix.

title.zh: Core i 看代数，新 Core 看 Series
title.en: Core i generations and new Core Series

body.zh: i7-13620H 和 i7-1355U 的前两位 13 都表示第 13 代。Core 7 150U 的 1 表示 Series 1。名称去掉 i，不一定代表换了新架构。
body.en: The 13 in i7-13620H and i7-1355U means 13th generation. The 1 in Core 7 150U means Series 1. Dropping i does not necessarily mean a new architecture.

title.zh: 同一 Series 也有不同架构
title.en: One Series can contain different architectures

body.zh: Ultra Series 2 中，225H / 275HX 使用 Arrow Lake，258V 使用 Lunar Lake。比较时要保留完整编号和后缀。
body.en: Within Ultra Series 2, 225H / 275HX use Arrow Lake; 258V uses Lunar Lake. Compare the full number and suffix.

title.en: X, N, and models without a suffix

body.zh: X7 / X9 是 Ultra Series 3 档位；无 X 的 338H 也有 Arc B370。N355 属于 N 系列。Core 7 350 没有后缀，仍是移动处理器。
body.en: X7 / X9 are Ultra Series 3 tiers; the 338H without X also has Arc B370. N355 belongs to the N-series. Core 7 350 is a mobile processor despite having no suffix.

title.zh: H 不固定功耗，HX 不保证集显更强
title.en: Suffixes do not fix power or graphics

body.zh: H 型号的基础功耗可为 25、28 或 45 W，需按型号查规格。非 Ultra 的 Core Series 3 也有 NPU；AI 功能还需应用支持。
body.en: H models can have base power ratings of 25, 28, or 45 W; check the exact SKU. Non-Ultra Core Series 3 also includes NPUs, and AI features still need app support.

meaning.zh: 注重移动能效

scope.zh: 部分传统 Core i、新 Core 和 Ultra 移动型号。
scope.en: Some traditional Core i, new Core, and Ultra mobile models.

limit.zh: 不等于固定 15 W，也不保证整机续航。
limit.en: Not a fixed 15 W rating or a battery-life guarantee.

meaning.zh: 高性能移动产品类别

scope.zh: Core i / Core / Core Ultra 多个分支。
scope.en: Multiple Core i / Core / Core Ultra branches.

limit.zh: 13620H 基础功耗 45 W、155H 为 28 W、358H 为 25 W；同字母不等于同瓦数。
limit.en: Base power is 45 W for 13620H, 28 W for 155H, and 25 W for 358H; the letter is not a fixed wattage.

meaning.zh: 更高性能移动平台；官方列为解锁类别
meaning.en: Higher-performance mobile platform; listed as unlocked

scope.zh: 部分 Core i / Core Ultra。
scope.en: Selected Core i / Core Ultra models.

limit.zh: 供电、散热和可调设置仍由整机决定；也不是必须配独显的含义。
limit.en: Laptop power, cooling, and exposed tuning controls still matter; it does not mean an integrated GPU is absent.

meaning.zh: Lunar Lake 分支

scope.zh: Core Ultra Series 2 的 200V。
scope.en: Core Ultra Series 2 200V.

limit.zh: 按特定分支读，不能排成 V＜U＜H 的通用性能阶梯。
limit.en: Specific to this branch, not a universal V < U < H performance ladder.

meaning.zh: 为轻薄本优化性能

scope.zh: 如第 12 / 13 代 Core i 的 P 系列。
scope.en: For example, 12th / 13th-generation Core i P models.

limit.zh: 不是 P 核数量，也不是 Professional。
limit.en: Not a P-core count or Professional branding.

meaning.zh: 高性能移动、解锁

scope.zh: 传统 Core i 的部分移动型号。
scope.en: Some traditional Core i mobile models.

limit.zh: 能否调节仍看电脑厂商开放的设置。
limit.en: Available tuning still depends on the laptop manufacturer.

meaning.zh: 旧款极低功耗移动类别

scope.zh: 旧 Core i / Core m 的部分型号。
scope.en: Some older Core i / Core m models.

limit.zh: 与今天的 V、U 是不同年代的命名。
limit.en: A different-era naming branch from current V / U.

meaning.zh: 旧款集显等级

scope.zh: 部分第 10 / 11 代 Core 移动型号。
scope.en: Some 10th / 11th-generation Core mobile models.

limit.zh: G7 不是第 7 代；同为 G7，具体 GPU 规模仍可能不同。
limit.en: G7 is not generation 7, and the exact GPU configuration can still differ.

meaning.zh: 更早的特定移动分支

scope.zh: HQ：移动高性能四核；单独 G：封装内含独立图形芯片。
scope.en: HQ: high-performance mobile quad-core; standalone G: discrete graphics in the package.

limit.zh: 单独 G 与 G7 含义不同。
limit.en: G on its own differs from G7.

meaning.zh: Ultra Series 3 档位

scope.zh: X 是档位的一部分，位于三位型号数字前。
scope.en: X is part of the tier, before the three-digit model number.

limit.zh: 不能套用旧型号尾缀 X / XE 的解锁含义。
limit.en: Do not apply the unlocked meaning of the older X / XE suffix.

meaning.zh: 正式名称可以没有字母
meaning.en: The official name may have no letter suffix

scope.zh: 如 Core 7 350、Ultra 7 355。
scope.en: For example, Core 7 350 and Ultra 7 355.

limit.zh: 无后缀也可能是移动处理器，按完整型号查规格。
limit.en: A model without a suffix can still be mobile. Check its full specifications.

meaning.zh: 同一 Series 内的增强 / 更新型号标记
meaning.en: Enhanced / updated model within the same Series

scope.zh: 如 Core Ultra 7 270HX Plus 仍是 Ultra Series 2。
scope.en: Core Ultra 7 270HX Plus remains Ultra Series 2.

limit.zh: 不是固定核心增量或加速百分比，查资料时保留完整名称。
limit.en: Not a fixed core-count increase or speedup percentage; retain the complete name.

overview.zh: Ryzen 四位数、三位数、Ryzen AI 和 AI Max 使用不同规则。
overview.en: Four-digit Ryzen, three-digit Ryzen, Ryzen AI, and AI Max use different rules.

title.en: 7000 / 8000: the third digit identifies architecture

body.zh: 7520U 是 Zen 2，7730U 是 Zen 3，7735HS 是 Zen 3+，7840HS / 8845HS 是 Zen 4。首位 7 指 2023 产品组合；7520U 实际在 2022 年发布。
body.en: 7520U is Zen 2; 7730U is Zen 3; 7735HS is Zen 3+; 7840HS / 8845HS are Zen 4. A leading 7 identifies the 2023 portfolio, although 7520U launched in 2022.

title.zh: 其他系列不能套这张表
title.en: Other families use different schemes

body.zh: 6000、三位数 Ryzen 100 / 200 / 400、Ryzen AI 和 Max 需分别查询。Ryzen 7 250 的 5、Ryzen AI 7 450 的 4，都不是架构编号。
body.en: Look up 6000, three-digit Ryzen 100 / 200 / 400, Ryzen AI, and Max separately. Neither the 5 in Ryzen 7 250 nor the 4 in Ryzen AI 7 450 identifies its architecture.

title.en: HX 370 and 9955HX have different power ranges

body.zh: Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 默认 28 W，可配置 15–54 W；Ryzen 9 9955HX 默认 55 W，可配置 55–75 W。比较 HX 时需带上完整系列名。
body.en: Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 defaults to 28 W with a 15–54 W configurable range. Ryzen 9 9955HX defaults to 55 W with a 55–75 W range. Keep the family name when comparing HX models.

title.en: AI, Max+, PRO, and 3D

body.zh: AI 是产品线；Max+ 395 / 392 / 388 分别有 16 / 12 / 8 核。PRO 表示商用功能，3D 表示特定型号配有 3D V-Cache。
body.en: AI names a product line. Max+ 395 / 392 / 388 have 16 / 12 / 8 CPU cores. PRO identifies business features; 3D marks selected models with 3D V-Cache.

meaning.zh: 偏移动能效的定位

scope.zh: 传统 Ryzen U 等型号。
scope.en: Traditional Ryzen U models and related branches.

limit.zh: 不锁定统一瓦数，也不保证比所有 HS 慢。
limit.en: No universal wattage or guarantee of being slower than every HS chip.

meaning.zh: 强调薄型高性能整机的定位

scope.zh: 多代传统 Ryzen 移动型号。
scope.en: Several generations of traditional Ryzen mobile chips.

limit.zh: 不是固定 35 W；例如 8840HS 官方默认 28 W。
limit.en: Not a fixed 35 W; for example, the official default for 8840HS is 28 W.

meaning.zh: 高性能移动类别

scope.zh: 部分传统 Ryzen，包含中国地区型号。
scope.en: Some traditional Ryzen chips, including regional China models.

limit.zh: 7840H 与 7840HS 都有 35–54 W 规格范围，不能硬排 H＞HS。
limit.en: 7840H and 7840HS both list a 35–54 W range; H > HS is not a universal rule.

meaning.zh: 必须结合家族识别的标记
meaning.en: A marker whose meaning depends on the family

scope.zh: 传统 Ryzen HX，与 Ryzen AI 名称中的 HX。
scope.en: Traditional Ryzen HX and HX within Ryzen AI names.

limit.zh: 9955HX 与 AI HX 370 的功耗定位不同；字母不是固定性能分数。
limit.en: 9955HX and AI HX 370 have different power positioning; the letters are not a performance score.

meaning.zh: 特定型号的 3D V-Cache 标记

scope.zh: 如 Ryzen 9 9955HX3D。
scope.en: For example, Ryzen 9 9955HX3D.

limit.zh: 主要收益需看具体游戏；渲染等任务不一定加速。
limit.en: Benefits depend on the game; tasks such as rendering may not improve.

meaning.zh: 商用安全、管理与平台支持
meaning.en: Business security, manageability, and platform support

scope.zh: Ryzen PRO、Ryzen AI PRO 等商用系列。
scope.en: Business lines such as Ryzen PRO and Ryzen AI PRO.

limit.zh: 重点是商用功能，不是额外的性能等级。
limit.en: This identifies business features rather than an extra performance tier.

meaning.zh: 较大规模的 AI Max 产品分支
meaning.en: AI Max product branches with larger resources

scope.zh: Ryzen AI Max 产品线，不能逐字猜 CPU / GPU 规模。
scope.en: The Ryzen AI Max line; do not infer exact CPU / GPU scale from the words.

limit.zh: Max+ 也有不同 CPU 核心配置；完整型号和内存更重要。
limit.en: Max+ includes different CPU core configurations; the exact model and memory still matter.

meaning.zh: 较早方案里的特定移动分支
meaning.en: Specific mobile branches in an earlier scheme

scope.zh: 原始命名表中，C 面向 Chromebook，e 为低功耗、无风扇方向的变体。
scope.en: The original naming chart uses C for Chromebook and e for lower-power, fanless variants.

limit.zh: 属于旧命名规则，实际配置按型号查询。
limit.en: These are older naming rules. Look up the exact configuration.

meaning.zh: 新系列也会省略传统后缀
meaning.en: Some newer families omit traditional suffixes

scope.zh: 如 Ryzen 7 170 / 250，Ryzen AI Max+ 395。
scope.en: For example, Ryzen 7 170 / 250 and Ryzen AI Max+ 395.

limit.zh: 没有 H / HX 不等于低功耗，也不表示没有集显。
limit.en: Missing H / HX does not establish low power or the absence of integrated graphics.

overview.zh: MacBook Air / Pro 是整机系列；M4、M4 Pro 等是芯片型号。芯片名之后，还需核对 CPU / GPU 核心配置。
overview.en: MacBook Air / Pro are laptop families; M4 and M4 Pro are chip names. Check the CPU / GPU configuration as well.

title.zh: 数字表示代际，Pro / Max 表示芯片分支
title.en: Generation numbers and chip variants

body.zh: M1–M5 是代际；基础 M、Pro、Max 的配置规模不同。跨代比较 M4 Pro 与 M5 时，需要结合具体任务。
body.en: M1–M5 identify generations. Base M, Pro, and Max have different configurations. Compare chips such as M4 Pro and M5 using your actual workload.

title.zh: 同名芯片可能有多种核心配置
title.en: One chip name can cover several configurations

body.zh: M4 Pro 有 12 核 CPU / 16 核 GPU、14 核 CPU / 20 核 GPU 两种配置。M5 Pro 和 M5 Max 都可为 18 核 CPU，Max 的主要增配不一定在 CPU。
body.en: M4 Pro has 12-core CPU / 16-core GPU and 14-core CPU / 20-core GPU configurations. Both M5 Pro and M5 Max can have 18 CPU cores; Max does not necessarily add CPU cores.

title.zh: MacBook Pro 不一定搭载 Pro 芯片
title.en: A MacBook Pro can use a base M chip

body.zh: MacBook Pro 也可搭载基础 M 芯片。Ultra 用于桌面 Mac，不是 MacBook 的可选芯片档位。
body.en: A MacBook Pro may use a base M chip. Ultra is used in desktop Macs, not as a MacBook chip option.

title.zh: A 系列与 M 系列分开看
title.en: A-series and M-series are separate families

body.zh: MacBook Neo 使用 A18 Pro，A 与 M 的编号不能直接比较。各代核心类型也有变化，具体组成需查规格。
body.en: MacBook Neo uses A18 Pro. A- and M-series numbers are not directly comparable. Core types also vary by generation; check the specifications.

meaning.zh: M 家族代际

scope.zh: Apple M 芯片名的一部分。
scope.en: Part of the Apple M chip name.

limit.zh: 性能需结合芯片分支和实际配置比较。
limit.en: Compare performance using the chip variant and configuration.

meaning.zh: M 家族中的芯片分支
meaning.en: A chip variant within the M family

scope.zh: 如 M4 Pro / M5 Pro；A18 Pro 的 Pro 则属于 A 家族。
scope.en: For example, M4 Pro / M5 Pro; Pro in A18 Pro belongs to the A family.

limit.zh: 不要与 MacBook Pro 整机名称混淆。
limit.en: Do not confuse it with the MacBook Pro laptop name.

meaning.zh: 不同资源配置的 M 芯片分支
meaning.en: M chip variants with different resources

scope.zh: 通常具有更大 GPU / 内存能力，实际规格按代和型号查。
scope.en: Typically offers larger GPU / memory resources; check each generation and model.

limit.zh: 不保证比同代 Pro 拥有更多 CPU 核心。
limit.en: Does not guarantee more CPU cores than the same-generation Pro.

meaning.zh: 桌面 Mac 的更大规模芯片分支
meaning.en: Larger chip variants used in desktop Macs

scope.zh: 如 Mac Studio 的官方配置。
scope.en: For example, official Mac Studio configurations.

limit.zh: 不要把它列成 MacBook 可选芯片；也不保证每代都有全部后缀。
limit.en: Not a MacBook chip option; not every generation necessarily offers every suffix.

meaning.zh: 两类不同的核心数量
meaning.en: Core counts for different processing units

scope.zh: 如 14 核 CPU + 20 核 GPU；另核对统一内存。
scope.en: For example, 14 CPU cores plus 20 GPU cores; check unified memory separately.

limit.zh: 两类核心分别计数；GPU 核心数也不能直接跨品牌比较。
limit.en: Count the two types separately. GPU core counts are not directly comparable across vendors.

meaning.zh: 整台笔记本的系列名称

scope.zh: MacBook Air / MacBook Pro。
scope.en: MacBook Air / MacBook Pro.

limit.zh: 整机上的 Pro 不保证芯片也有 Pro 后缀。
limit.en: Pro in the laptop name does not guarantee a Pro chip suffix.

overview.zh: 先看 Snapdragon X / X2 和 Plus / Elite 等系列名，再用完整料号确认配置，例如 X1E-78-100。
overview.en: Read the Snapdragon X / X2 and Plus / Elite family names, then check the full part number, such as X1E-78-100.

title.zh: 系列名之外，还要看料号
title.en: Check the part number as well as the family

body.zh: 同叫 Snapdragon X Elite，频率和 GPU 可能不同。X2E 前缀还同时用于 Elite 和 Elite Extreme。
body.en: Snapdragon X Elite models can differ in clock speeds and GPU. The X2E prefix covers both Elite and Elite Extreme.

title.zh: X1 / X2 表示代际，中间数字区分型号
title.en: X1 / X2 identify generation; middle digits identify the SKU

body.zh: X1P-42-100 有 8 核，X2P-42-100 有 6 核。跨代相同的 42 不代表相同配置。
body.en: X1P-42-100 has 8 CPU cores; X2P-42-100 has 6. The same 42 across generations does not mean the same configuration.

title.en: Oryon, Adreno, and Hexagon

body.zh: Oryon 是 CPU，Adreno 是 GPU，Hexagon 是 NPU。查游戏表现时，需核对 Adreno 的完整型号和频率。
body.en: Oryon is the CPU, Adreno the GPU, and Hexagon the NPU. For gaming, check the exact Adreno model and clock speed.

title.en: Keep the 100 / 101 ending

body.zh: X1-26-100 与 X1-26-101 的 GPU 有差别。末段是料号的一部分，没有公开的通用功耗或内存解码规则。
body.en: X1-26-100 and X1-26-101 have different GPUs. The ending is part of the identifier; there is no public universal rule for decoding it into power or memory.

meaning.zh: PC 平台家族

scope.zh: 产品名中的 Snapdragon X / X2。
scope.en: Snapdragon X / X2 in product names.

limit.zh: 不要套手机 Snapdragon 8 系列的规则。
limit.en: Do not apply the phone Snapdragon 8 numbering scheme.

meaning.zh: 料号中的平台代际线索
meaning.en: Platform-generation clue in the part number

scope.en: For example, X1E-78-100 and X2E-88-100.

limit.zh: 同一代还有多种 CPU / GPU 配置。
limit.en: Each generation contains several CPU / GPU configurations.

meaning.zh: Elite 家族

scope.zh: 第一代 X1E；第二代 X2E 还涵盖 Elite Extreme。
scope.en: First-generation X1E; second-generation X2E also covers Elite Extreme.

limit.zh: 单凭 E 不能得知完整产品档位、频率或 GPU。
limit.en: E alone does not identify the full tier, clocks, or GPU.

meaning.zh: Plus 分支

scope.zh: X1P / X2P。
scope.en: X1P / X2P.

limit.zh: Plus 名称不固定为 8 核或 10 核。
limit.en: Plus does not fix the chip at 8 or 10 cores.

meaning.zh: 具体 SKU 编号

scope.zh: 需要连同 X1 / X2 和 E / P 查询。
scope.en: Look up with X1 / X2 and E / P.

limit.zh: 只用于区分型号，跨代不能按数字大小排性能。
limit.en: These distinguish SKUs, not performance across generations.

meaning.zh: 完整配置料号的一部分
meaning.en: Part of the complete configuration code

scope.zh: 查表时保留整个 X1E-78-100 等料号。
scope.en: Keep the whole code, such as X1E-78-100, for lookup.

limit.zh: 没有把末段每一位通用换算成内存、功耗或 FPS 的公开规则。
limit.en: No general public digit rule maps this ending to memory, power, or FPS.

intel-n.en: Intel Processor N / Core N: identify the N branch first

amd-ai.zh: Ryzen AI：家族 + 档位 + 可选 HX + 三位型号
amd-ai.en: Ryzen AI: family + tier + optional HX + three-digit SKU

amd-max.zh: Ryzen AI Max / Max+：整体系列标签 + 型号
amd-max.en: Ryzen AI Max / Max+: complete family label + SKU

amd-short.zh: Ryzen 三位短编号：按具体系列查规格
amd-short.en: Three-digit Ryzen: look up the exact family

apple-m.zh: Apple M：家族 + 代际 + 可选芯片分支
apple-m.en: Apple M: family + generation + optional chip variant

apple-a.zh: Apple A：与 M 不同的芯片家族
apple-a.en: Apple A: a chip family separate from M

qualcomm-x.zh: Snapdragon X / X2：产品名 + 完整料号
qualcomm-x.en: Snapdragon X / X2: product name + complete part number

lookup.zh: 该名称需要按官方完整型号查询
lookup.en: Look up this full model name in official specifications
